title: The batch gate has first claim and retries a timeout at once on the newest main
description: Runs the real gate step over a git origin with the one merge slot taken: the gate starts anyway, master status shows it holding first claim on trial slots with implementation launches paused, and a forced timeout restarts the gate in the same flight on main's newest tip, which it verifies.

steps.name: the gate holds first claim; a timeout retries on the newest tip
